Risk-set summaries at the distinct event times

Source: R/RiskTable.R
RiskTable.Rd

Tabulates, for every distinct event time (within strata when strata is given), the numbers of treated and control subjects at risk just before that time and the numbers of treated and total events at that time. All estimators of EstHR except "Cox" are computed from these summaries, and this function returns them from the same internal code.

Usage

RiskTable(
  time,
  event,
  group,
  control,
  strata = NULL,
  is_sorted = FALSE,
  data = NULL
)

Arguments

time

Numeric vector of follow-up times, or a formula Surv(time, event) ~ group, optionally with + strata(s) (see Formula interface in Details).

event

Vector of event indicators, 1 (event) or 0 (censored), or logical, aligned with time. With a formula, the data frame may be given here instead of in data, as in coxph(formula, data).

group

Vector of group labels aligned with time. Subjects with group != control form the treatment group. Not used with a formula.

control

Single value of group that identifies the control group. With a formula, the default is the first level of the group variable if it is a factor and its smallest value otherwise, which is the reference level of coxph().

strata

Optional vector of stratum labels aligned with time. Each stratum has its own baseline hazard and the HR is common to all strata. Default NULL (no stratification). With a formula, strata are given by strata() in the formula instead.

is_sorted

Logical. If TRUE, the rows are taken to be sorted in ascending order of time within strata, with the rows of each stratum contiguous, and the internal sorting is skipped. An error is raised if they are not. Default FALSE.

data

A data frame (or list) in which the variables of a formula are evaluated. Used only with a formula. Default NULL (the environment of the formula).

Value

A data frame with one row per distinct event time within stratum, ordered by stratum and time, and the columns

stratum

Stratum label (only when strata is given).

time

Event time.

n_T, n_C

Numbers at risk in the treatment and control groups just before time.

O_T

Number of events in the treatment group at time.

O

Total number of events at time.

The counts are stored as doubles.

Details

Subjects censored at an event time are counted as at risk at that time, as in survival::coxph(). Times are tied only when they are exactly equal. The data are given as vectors or by a formula Surv(time, event) ~ group + strata(s), as in EstHR (see Formula interface in its Details); rows with missing values are then removed.

See also

EstHR.

Examples

time  <- c(1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6)
event <- c(1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1)
group <- c("C", "T", "C", "T", "C", "T", "T", "C", "C", "T")
RiskTable(time, event, group, control = "C")
#>   time n_T n_C O_T O
#> 1    1   5   5   1 2
#> 2    2   4   4   0 1
#> 3    3   3   3   1 2
#> 4    4   2   2   1 1
#> 5    5   1   2   0 1
#> 6    6   1   0   1 1
RiskTable(time, event, group, control = "C",
          strata = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 5))
#>   stratum time n_T n_C O_T O
#> 1       a    1   2   3   1 2
#> 2       a    2   1   2   0 1
#> 3       a    3   0   1   0 1
#> 4       b    3   3   2   1 1
#> 5       b    4   2   2   1 1
#> 6       b    5   1   2   0 1
#> 7       b    6   1   0   1 1

# Formula interface
head(RiskTable(Surv(rfstime, status) ~ hormon + strata(grade),
               data = survival::gbsg))
#>   stratum time n_T n_C O_T O
#> 1       1  476  28  45   0 1
#> 2       1  559  28  43   1 1
#> 3       1  637  27  43   0 1
#> 4       1  662  27  42   1 1
#> 5       1  707  25  42   0 1
#> 6       1  795  23  39   0 1
